game.rules:
All emulators are banned for Console runs.

Any **unauthorised** modifications and codes are banned. This includes the use of unofficial skins, or cosmetic modifications to the game.

The following modifications are **allowed** for PC runs:

- Always Run in Background 
- Quick Boot options
- Custom Cyloop Colors
- Silent Main Menu
- Any extra options provided by the AutoSplitter

Official cosmetic costumes and skins are allowed provided no tangible advantage is gained from them.

Runs must have suitable video. Only permanent video sources are accepted (**YouTube links or similar**). Other video hosting sites (such as Twitter, Medal.tv, Twitch, or similar) will be rejected.

In order to properly verify the LRT for PC runs, LiveSplit must be shown with the appropriate comparison.

When submitting RTA (Real-time attack), please leave the milliseconds field **empty**.

relatedGames.rules:
##### General Rules

- All **Emulators** are *banned*. 

- As of 2022-11-22, any unauthorized **mods/codes/cheats** are *banned*. As of 2022-12-07, The Livesplit option "Prevent from pausing when it goes out of focus" and the corresponding code "Always run in background" in the Mod Manager are legal for runs.

- As of 2022-11-22, all runs under **individual category thresholds** require video proof or submissions will be rejected. Please check category rules for more info.

- Official Cosmetic DLCs (i.e. Korone, Soap Shoes, etc.), as long as no advantage is gained from them are allowed in all categories unless stated otherwise.

- Video evidence must accompany any submitted run. Video should include before the stage starts, all gameplay in the stage, and the results screen after the stage. Only permanent video services will be accepted (YouTube links or similar). Non-permanent video will be rejected (Twitch VODs, Streamable links, etc.).

- When submitting, please leave the RTA MS FIELD empty. We do not track MS for real-time runs.

##### PC Rules:

- Runs are mainly timed using a Loadless Game Timer or In Game Time on Livesplit. Any runs recorded without it will be placed under the ones using it.

*If you don't know how to set it up, please refer to [this guide](/https://www.speedrun.com/sonicfrontiers/guide/1hv3v).*

##### Console-Specific rules:

- Runs are only timed using **RTA**, so leave the **IGT** field empty.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
# Objective

Beat the game as fast as possible from a New Game file.

# Restrictions

- You must beat the game via the base game. Runs completed on Another Story must be submitted to the Another Ending category extension.
- Difficulty is irrelevant, it does not matter if you decide to beat THE END on Easy/Normal mode, or Hard mode.
- Paid DLC, such as Bonuses, are allowed provided you do not use any of the advantages they provide. For example you may not fall below 16.6 skill points at any point in your run if you use the Pre-order bonus. Runs using bonus DLC will be subject to a higher level of scrutiny, at verifier discretion.
- You are allowed to use post-game benefits, such as Power Boost in Cyber Space.

# Timing

Timing starts when selecting between Action style or High-speed style.

Timing ends when you input the last quick-time event to defeat THE END.

categories.name: All Gold Medals
categories.rules:
# Objective

Collect every gold medal and 100% clear the maps from a New Game file.

# Restrictions

- You only need to beat the base game; Another Story is irrelevant.
- Paid DLC, such as Bonuses, are allowed provided you do not use any of the advantages they provide. For example you may not fall below 16.6 skill points at any point in your run if you use the Pre-order bonus. Runs using bonus DLC will be subject to a higher level of scrutiny, at verifier discretion.
- You are allowed to use post-game benefits, such as Power Boost in Cyber Space.

# Gold Medal requirements:

- Defeat every guardian on all islands
- Complete all missions on every Cyber Space level
- Catch all fishes on every island (32 per island)
- Collect every Memory Token on all islands
- Finish all the side stories (Talk to Sage and Amy/Knuckles/Tails)
- Get S-Rank on every Action Chain Challenge
- Find all Special Kocos
- Complete all the map challenges (Islands should be mapped to 100%)

# Timing

Timing starts when selecting between Action style or High-speed style.

Timing ends when you finish the last objective earning you the last gold medal.

categories.name: Restricted
categories.rules:
# Objective

Beat the stage as fast as possible.

# Restrictions

- This must be played with the setting "Cyber Space Power Boost" **off**.
- You must have your deacceleration settings set to 100%.
- Spin Dash is **not** permitted.

These restrictions can be verified by use of the Action Marks next to your final time. You are only permitted to have the white Action Mark (indicating Homing Dash) and the purple Action Mark (indicating Maintain Boost during a Jump) in the Restricted category. Runs with other Action Marks (red for Spin Dash, yellow for Deceleration changes, blue for Power Boost) must be submitted to the Unrestricted category.

It is preferred that you include the Results Screen at the end of the VOD, for easier and better verification.

# Timing

- Levels are timed purely with the in-game timer.
- When submitting your runs, please only fill in In-Game Time (IGT).

Beat the game as fast as possible from a New Game file, whilst only using limited tech and skips

# Restrictions

- Difficulty is irrelevant, it does not matter if you decide to beat THE END on Easy/Normal mode, or Hard mode.

For example you may not fall below 16.6 skill points at any point in your run if you use the Pre-order bonus. Runs using bonus DLC will be subject to a higher level of scrutiny, at verifier discretion.
- You are allowed to use post-game benefits, such as Power Boost in Cyber Space.

# LTS Guidelines

### Banned skips:

- Methods to skip the tutorial segment (up to rebuilding the bridge after 1-2)
- Utilizing boss debug triggers (GIGANTO, WYVERN)
- Skipping Wyvern chase sequences (WESS)
- Skipping the Bridge The Gap minigame (Bridge Skip)

### Banned tech:

- Hedgehog Space Program - Gaining unreasonable height from stomping an enemy
- Slingshot - Gaining unreasonable distance from stomping an enemy
- Hit and Run - Cancelling Spin Slash to gain unreasonable speed
- Emerald Storage
- Cross Slash Warping - Exploiting the Cross Slash bug to warp
- Item Duplication
- Hyperbounce - Stomping on a raising platform to gain unreasonable height

**Note**: Accidentally performing a banned trick is acceptable, as long as no (tangible) advantage is gained from them. This will be at verifier discretion.

# Timing

Timing starts when selecting between Action style or High-speed style.

Timing ends when you input the last quick-time event to defeat THE END.

6) Killing all guardians once (blue star beside their name during combat).
